_comment: NOT A FHIR RESOURCE. This is the CDS Hooks discovery document IBX's system exposes at {endpoint-ibx address}/cds-services, per the CDS Hooks specification. An EHR (e.g., FCCC's Oracle Health/Cerner) queries this endpoint to discover available CDS services before firing the order-sign hook. Included here because it's a required piece of configuration for Encounter #1 to actually execute, even though it isn't itself a loadable FHIR resource.

services.title: IBX IMRT Prior Authorization Coverage Check
services.description: Evaluates whether an IMRT order requires prior authorization under the patient's IBX coverage, per PlanDefinition/plandef-ibx-imrt-pa-rule. Returns a card directing the ordering system to launch DTR (Questionnaire/questionnaire-ibx-imrt-pa-dtr) if prior authorization is required.
